Environmental graphics · Installation

One installation. More than one perspective.

An environmental-graphics concept that changes what viewers see as they move around it.

RoleEnvironmental graphics & illustration
ScopeIllustration, spatial concept, physical mockup
ContextInstallation project

The context

Make room for different viewpoints

Created around Ahmedabad’s Conflictorium Museum, the installation explores diverse perspectives. It was designed for a Constitution Day exhibition at GMDC ground, with potential applications in museum corridors or on walls.

The experience

Movement reveals another reading

From one viewpoint, the panels present an illustration of what Conflictorium represents. From another, words communicate its essence. The viewer’s movement becomes the interaction that connects these two expressions.

Outcome

What the work brings together.

An illustrated installation concept and physical mockup demonstrating how alternating viewpoints can change the message a visitor encounters.
